items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: we had Raymond Brown first, trombone player... And we named that band... called it the Golden Rules, uh, Jazz Band

ctx.x: Louis made a record with him, didn't he, with that, with that same band?
Yeah, his last band. And we did lots, I mean, I didn't make this last time I made the record, but we did a whole lot of, uh, television work for the, uh, we did a show around the town with Mr. Brown.
